policy: Use the main actor's country when no event location is available. Explicit event locations take precedence; publisher geography and personal-name homonyms do not establish actor nationality.
reviewBasis: User explicitly selected actor-country fallback during the geoparsing accuracy fixes. Original v1 fixture labels remain unchanged for historical comparison.

golden.reason: US presidential quantum-policy orders have national scope. 'White House says' is attribution, not evidence of a signing venue.
Russian Defence Ministry is the explicit principal actor; use a coarse Russian country anchor when the briefing's incident venues remain unresolved.
Federal ruling on the Trump administration's voter-verification system has an identifiable US institutional actor and national scope.
Trump administration/Department of Justice national policy supports the US country even without a physical venue.

stratified.reason: China is the explicit principal actor in a policy article; contextual White House and US mentions do not move it to Washington.
